title: 12-month outcomes of ab interno excisional goniotomy combined with cataract surgery in primary open-angle glaucoma and normal tension glaucoma

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License)

indication: open-angle glaucoma (primary open-angle glaucoma or normal tension glaucoma) with visually significant cataract, on topical IOP-lowering medication; adults; phacoemulsification combined with Kahook Dual Blade excisional goniotomy (90 or 120 degrees); prospective case series, one eye per patient

groups.description: Primary open-angle glaucoma eyes after phacoemulsification + Kahook Dual Blade goniotomy (Table 1 row label 'POAG (n = 55)')
Normal tension glaucoma eyes after phacoemulsification + Kahook Dual Blade goniotomy (Table 1 row label 'NTG (n = 14)')

exclusions.what: Table 2 (Tab2) all cases, 90° Kahook and 120° Kahook columns
exclusions.reason: IOP at 12 months only, without a preoperative reference in the table; the all-cases column also duplicates the eyes of the Table 1 subgroups and the 90°/120° sub-analysis omits eyes treated between 100 and 110 degrees

exclusions.what: Table 1 rows R3 and R5 (number of IOP-lowering medications)
exclusions.reason: medication counts are mentioned in notes only (no medication series in schema 1.0.0)

exclusions.what: IOP reductions, percent reductions and success proportions given in the Results text
exclusions.reason: not table cells; changes and success proportions are not extracted when the absolute IOP series is tabulated
excluded from the analysis by the authors (not an outcome-defined exclusion); the remaining completers set is kept as ordinary attrition

notes: Reference: preoperative visit about 4 weeks before surgery; all patients were using IOP-lowering medication before surgery, so the reference is recorded as preoperative_medicated.
Table 1 also tabulates the number of IOP-lowering medications at each visit (rows R3 and R5); not extracted.
The Abstract reports a different SD for the POAG preoperative IOP than Table 1; the Table 1 cells are cited.
Inclusion required uneventful cataract surgery (intraoperative criterion); the authors state that no eye needed another glaucoma surgery within 12 months.
Figures 1 and 2 show IOP and medication data graphically; not used.

series.notes: mean ± SD; columns 'Preoperative', '2 months postoperative', '6 months postoperative', '12 months postoperative'; analysis set restricted by the authors to eyes that completed the 12-month follow-up, so the same eyes contribute at every visit
mean ± SD; columns 'Preoperative', '2 months postoperative', '6 months postoperative', '12 months postoperative'; analysis set restricted by the authors to eyes that completed the 12-month follow-up
